description: Write a dental pre-authorisation request or claim narrative that gets approved the first time — the diagnosis, the documented failure of lesser treatment, and the attachments a reviewer needs, assembled in the order they assess them. Use when asked to write a pre-auth, submit a predetermination, appeal a denied dental claim, or write a narrative for a crown, implant, or perio case. Administrative support only; clinical justification must come from the treating clinician's own findings.
